description: Source code for the driver of the ST Microelectronics LSM6DSV16X 6-axis IMU sensor, including external sensor support and configuration functions.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_shub_write_target_reg
methods.description: Writes data to a target register of an external sensor via the sensor hub.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_shub_read_target_reg
methods.description: Reads data from a target register of an external sensor via the sensor hub.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_shub_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the sensor hub and associated accelerometer.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_shub_wait_completed
methods.description: Waits for the external sensor operation to complete.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_shub_set_data_channel
methods.description: Configures data channels for external sensors.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_shub_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor hub and external sensors.
